$note: The rent regimes the site's rules hold, and each regime's published allowance for a dated period. A regime here is a rule in regulatory_rules.json that regulates rent; a rule that states a state preempts or bans rent control is listed under noRegime. An allowance is filed only as a primary source printed it — from the GitHub runner (zori.yml probe_url) or as the rule's own verification already records it — with the period it covers, never carried past its end and never estimated. lib/rent-regulation reads this file; lib/rent-regulation.test.ts holds every rent rule to one of the two lists.
